Library.Title: Cypher Library
Library.Pilot: Pilot library: seven CRD reference selections and a first task aid. Full chapters and guides are being built.
Library.TaskHint: Read Task Difficulty and Effort and Edge above, then consult a linked Skill if needed. Choose your character and stat, then use the standard task dialog to declare difficulty, a relevant acquired Skill, assets and Effort. The GM decides whether the task and circumstances apply. Opening a Skill reference does not grant that Skill or select it for the roll.
Library.PlayerPending: More player procedures and quick references will be added here.
Library.GMPending: The full GM guide and screen will be added here. Preview a cypher below, then award it separately from the character sheet.
Library.DrawHint: Preview only: this does not award or consume a cypher, and does not publish a chat message. Only the active elected GM can generate the result.
Library.TablesPending: More random tools and native tables will be added here.
Library.ShortcutHint: Create or reopen your personal home macro, then drag it from the Macros directory to a free hotbar slot. Your hotbar is left as it is.
Library.ShortcutDenied: Creating this shortcut requires permission to create macros and execute script macros. The library remains accessible from Journals and the character sheet.
Library.MacrosPending: More player and GM shortcuts will be added here.
Library.Unavailable: This reference is unavailable or you do not have permission to read it.
Library.NoActor: You need an owned player character to make a task roll.
